request.query: Evaluation of multivariate polynomial as finite sum of coefficients times products of powers

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Fintype σ]
  (g : R →+* S₁) (X : σ → S₁) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ g X f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, g (MvPolynomial.coeff d f) * ∏ i, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (g : R →+* S₁)
  (X : σ → S₁) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ g X f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, g (MvPolynomial.coeff d f) * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} (x : R),
  Polynomial.eval x p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), p.coeff i * x ^ i
